sentence: Related Penalty Section 6662(a) and (b)(1) and (2) imposes an accuracy-related penalty equal to 20% of the amount of any underpayment of tax that is due to the taxpayer's negligence or disregard of rules or regulations or that is attributable to any substantial understatement of income tax.

Under section 6662(d)(1), there is a substantial understatement of income tax if the amount of the understatement exceeds the greater of (1) 10 percent of the tax required to be shown on the return or (2) $5,000.

We have examined those copies and, based on the deficiencies in tax determined by respondent, which we will sustain, we find that all of the underpayments of tax here in question are attributable to substantial understatements of tax.
Petitioner's understatement is $4,970 ; thus, respondent has not met his burden of production with respect to a substantial understatement under section 6662(b)(2) and (d) (1) .

Because we find that the Ramigs' underpayment is attributable to negligence or disregard of rules or regulations, we do not address whether it is also attributable to a substantial understatement of income tax.
The understatement thus constitutes a “substantial understatement”.
